entry.desc: Full pathname of the photolysis rate lookup table (radiative source function) used for long-wavelength photolysis. Source: CAM mo_jlong.F90 jlong_init

Full pathname of the text file of Chebyshev polynomial coefficients for the effective O2 cross sections in the Schumann-Runge bands. Read only when the mechanism carries O, O2, O3, N2 and NO, which activates the short-wavelength (below 200 nm) photolysis path. Source: CAM mo_jshort.F90 xs_init

Full pathname of the cross-section and quantum yield data file for wavelengths below 200 nm. Read only when the short-wavelength photolysis path is active (see xs_coef_file). CAM's cam7 physics uses the c250124 file. Source: CAM mo_jshort.F90 get_crs
Full pathname of the long-wavelength cross-section and quantum yield data file (temperature and pressure dependent). Source: CAM mo_jlong.F90 jlong_init

Full pathname of the monthly zonal-mean O3 and O2 column densities above the model top. Used only by mechanisms carrying O3 as a solution species; empty disables the columns above the top. Source: CAM mo_photo.F90 photo_inti
Maximum solar zenith angle (degrees) for which photolysis rates are computed; beyond it the rates are zero. CAM's default for the tropospheric table path is 97.01.
